changelog: Initial release: citation-backed Q&A, Studio generation, quota-aware batch pattern.
summary: This skill should be used when the user wants to query their Google NotebookLM notebooks for citation-backed, source-grounded answers, or manage notebooks, sources, and Studio content (audio, report, video, infographic, presentation, data table, flashcards, quiz, mind map). It drives the @roomi-fields/notebooklm-mcp engine — via the notebooklm MCP tools when they are available in the session, otherwise via its HTTP REST API — and covers Google login, citation formats, the daily-quota-aware batch/ingestion pattern, and source discovery.
